title: McpPolicy
description: MCP server policy + status payloads: mcp_get_status / mcp_set_policy / mcp_confirm_pending (Rust mirror: src-tauri/src/mcp/policy.rs). Governs what a connected MCP agent may do; transport security (loopback bind, bearer token, Origin validation) is NOT configurable here by design — see ARCHITECTURE §12.3. Emitter contract — no additionalProperties:false (D-06).

toolName.description: One of the curated MCP tools (frozen roster, ARCHITECTURE §12.2).

mode.description: readOnly: only read-only tools. confirmDestructive (default): destructive tools park on a UI confirmation. full: everything allowed (explicit user opt-in).

toolOverrides.description: Per-tool rule overriding mode. Unknown tool names are always denied regardless of policy.

port.description: TCP port on 127.0.0.1 (the bind address is not configurable). Applied on next server start.

pendingConfirmation.title: PendingConfirmation
pendingConfirmation.description: A destructive tool call parked awaiting the user's approve/deny (resolved via mcp_confirm_pending; times out to deny).

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner for the confirm dialog.

tokenFingerprint.description: First 8 hex chars of the session token. The full token is NEVER part of any IPC payload or log line.
